name: Lian Weizhou
current_role: Former CEO and co-founder, Longtop Financial Technologies (Xiamen; NYSE-delisted 2011); current role unknown
profile: Co-founded Longtop with Jia Xiaogong in Xiamen in 1996, building it into a software and IT-services provider for Chinese banks that listed on the NYSE in 2007. The company was delisted in 2011 and he has kept no public profile since.
interesting_fact: Longtop was one of the largest Chinese software firms serving the banking sector when it listed on the NYSE in 2007.
notes: Longtop collapsed in 2011 amid an accounting-fraud scandal and SEC litigation; no public presence or contact found since. Not a recommended outreach target.

name: Ajay S Shriram
current_role: Chairman & Senior Managing Director, DCM Shriram Ltd (New Delhi)
profile: Indian industrialist who leads DCM Shriram, the diversified group spanning chloro-vinyl chemicals, sugar, fertilisers, Shriram Farm Solutions and Bioseed. A B.Com graduate of Sydenham College, Bombay, he also attended Harvard Business School's Program for Management Development, and he was president of the Confederation of Indian Industry (CII) in 2014-15.
interesting_fact: He chairs the Governing Body of Shri Ram College of Commerce (SRCC), the Delhi college his family founded, and chairs the board of IIM Sirmaur.
deep_cut_fact: Before leading CII, he was President and Chairman of the Paris-based International Fertilizer Industry Association (2009-11), and earlier he chaired the Fertilizer Association of India (2000-02).
notes: The press email is DCM Shriram's published Corporate Communication/CSR contact (Ms. Aman Pannu). The group's chlor-alkali business is power-intensive and runs captive power plants, which could make a good energy angle.
